problem_type: Layer-split paid job recovery and custom-script admission boundary
symptom: Recovering a paid layer-split job across window close, restart or manual retrieve-again could lose layer metadata or archetype modeId, and attaching a custom call script to layer-split spent credits while returning a flat image without layers.
direct_cause: CanvasTransportProvider omitted explicit layers typing and dropped archetype modeId on fallback fetchResult queries, while taskParams and customCallDispatch exempted script routes from the layer-split wire contract.
class_root: Structured terminal semantics (layers) and structured output admission (layer-split vs script-only asset URLs) must be preserved and enforced at the shared canvas Run and pre-spend dispatch boundaries.
affected_population: Creators running or recovering paid layer-split tasks on canvas nodes and configuring custom call scripts on image models
entry_points: Canvas single-shot background settlement, app restart replay/poll and manual retrieve-again
Canvas quick-action layer-split derivation, custom call scope selector and pre-spend task dispatch
internal_only_reason: The canvas Run snapshot, task parameter pre-spend validation and custom call script contract are repository-owned boundaries.
invariants: Every settled layer-split Run preserves layers[] in settledResult and forwards archetype modeId when querying unfinished jobs across restart, landing as one editable whiteboard with +0 extra POSTs.
Layer-split mode cannot be selected for or dispatched through a custom call script before spend.

door_reduction.why_not: Online generation and recovery already converge on readSettledCanvasResult and landTaskResults; pre-spend parameter validation and custom call dispatch share assertLayerSplitNotScriptRouted without adding new dispatch doors.

generality_proof: Any mode marked with layerSplit on its archetype is automatically rejected on script routes in both UI capability checks and main-process pre-spend validation, and its layers[] metadata rides the whole-object settledResult snapshot across background settlement, restart and manual retrieval.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Forward frozen archetype modeId on fallback fetchResult queries and preserve layers[] in the settled Run snapshot across online completion, background settlement and restart replay.
Refuse layer-split requests routed to custom call scripts before spend or outbound HTTP.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Forwards frozen archetype modeId on fallback fetchResult queries and preserves layers[] in materialized raw receipt.
Calls assertLayerSplitNotScriptRouted before spend on both Engine A and Engine B.
Calls assertLayerSplitNotScriptRouted before local asset transport or spendGate.
Excludes models with customCallScriptModes containing layers and surfaces layer-split-custom-script block reason.
Marks layer-split scope disabled with explicit explanation in the script scope selector.

recurrence.reason: Structured task outputs (layers, transcripts, provenance) cross both Run snapshot replay and custom-script bypass routes.
same_class_scan: door-map createCanvasTransportProvider readSettledCanvasResult recoverAcceptedTask landTaskResults applyHeadlessParamDefaults runCustomCallTask canLayerSplit resolveCustomCallScriptModes
Inspected all isLayerSplitMode and layerSplitWireReady call sites across electron/ and src/.

prevention.invariant: Layer-split tasks never execute via custom call scripts and always recover full layers[] from the Run envelope.
prevention.failure_mode: Scripted layer-split fails pre-spend with ModeRouteMissingError; incomplete layer downloads fail into recoverable retrieval-download without polluting node version history.
prevention.strategy: Enforce at shared pre-spend taskParams/customCallDispatch boundary and Run settledResult snapshot.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the route.sends !== script exemption that allowed layer-split requests to bypass wire validation into custom call scripts.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Canvas Run snapshot and catalog task dispatch are repository-owned subsystems.

migration: Existing Run snapshots with settledResult replay layers directly; models with a legacy saved layers script remain removable in CustomCallEditor while blocked from new layer-split runs.
residual_risks: Live upstream APIMart layer payload shape verification requires the single real-paid check coordinated outside free rehearsal.
